a.lede: The Plymouth City Council was left with no choice but to physically disconnect the cameras after Flock failed to respond to its demands.
a.title: Police Chief physically unplugs Flock cameras after the company ignores contract cancellation

b.lede: Dayton, MN's city council removed Flock cameras and canceled its contract in August, but Flock reinstalled cameras anyway, almost a month after the program's suspension.
b.title: Flock ignores Minnesota city’s orders not to reinstall AI surveillance cameras
